title: IssueRequest
description: PUT /api/v1/processing/issues/:fingerprint (scope issues:write). open -> resolved/waived emits issue_resolved; a new open issue emits issue_opened.

kind.description: Altair issue kind, e.g. PROJECT_UNRESOLVED, HUB_CONFIG_MISMATCH, STALE_REFERENCE (SPEC §10.1).

requirement.description: What must be true for the issue to resolve itself.

scope.description: Altair's issue scope (rig, project, night, filter, hub_target_id...).
